contractChanges: Valid authorized requests now perform one runtimeModelPolicy:ensureBudget call after native authorize/checkAuthority, before business reads/writes or model construction. Default fixture policy denies with static CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE/not_dispatched.

Temporary assertions that semantic fields are ignored when policy is unavailable are replaced with auth-first semantic validation and denial-path getter opacity. No auth/control assertion was removed.

All176 native boundary cases retain exact exportArgs validation, tenfield frozen projection, generation fences, descriptor/getter opacity and static envelopes. All67 public closure cases retain no writes/business reads/vector/model effects on preflight failure.
functionalCoverage: Real authenticated remember normalizes source, persists one source/chunk/vector/fact/receipt and returns authoritative confidence91/lineage; real recall applies owned scope/profile filtering and returns memory+fact context.

Exact trusted reference/canonical request budget preflight precedes source writes; normalized replay reuses controlled account and actual derived receipt without duplicate writes; changed text or recalllimit denies before second model.
Unconfigured policy and missing JWT/revoked/foreign/capability authority deny before source/facts/vectors/model; semantic request/limit invalidity precedes budget.

Revocation after preflight or extraction, actual source-revision race at writeDerived, provider diagnostics/getters, malformed extraction/invalid vector and postquery model failure produce exact static MEMORY_OPERATION_FAILED/uncertain and no derived commit/partial recall.
